lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਜੂਰੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir rav rahiaa bharapoore vekh hajoore jug jug eko jaataa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is all-pervading everywhere; behold Him ever-present. Throughout the ages, know Him as the One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਬਾਲੀ ਭੋਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan baalee bholee pir sahaj raavai miliaa karam bidhaataa ||
lines.translation: The young, innocent bride enjoys her Husband Lord; she meets Him, the Architect of karma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har ras chaakhiaa sabad subhaakhiaa har sar rahee bharapoore ||
lines.translation: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord, and utters the sublime Word of the Shabad, remains immersed in the Lord's Ambrosial Pool.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹੈ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman saa pir bhaavai sabade rahai hadoore ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that soul bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, who, through the Shabad, remains in His Presence. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਮੁਈਏ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee jaai poochhahu mueee jinee vichahu aap gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Go and ask the happy soul-brides, O mortal bride, who have eradicated their self-conceit from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮੁਈਏ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir kaa hukam na paaio mueee jinee vichahu aap na gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who have not eradicated their self-conceit, O mortal bride, do not realize the Hukam of their Husband Lord's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee aap gavaaiaa tinee pir paaiaa ra(n)g siu raleeaa maanai ||
lines.translation: Those who eradicate their self-conceit, obtain their Husband Lord; they delight in His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ra(n)g raatee sahaje maatee anadin naam vakhaanai ||
lines.translation: Ever imbued with His Love, in perfect poise and grace, she repeats His Name, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaman vadabhaagee a(n)tar liv laagee har kaa prem subhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Very fortunate is that bride, who focuses her consciousness on Him; her Lord's Love is so sweet to her.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman sahaje raatee jin sach seegaar banaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that soul-bride who is adorned with Truth, is imbued with her Lord's Love, in the state of perfect poise. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮੁਈਏ ਤੂ ਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar mueee too chal gur kai bhaae ||
lines.translation: Overcome your egotism, O mortal bride, and walk in the Guru's Way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਈਏ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har var raavahi sadaa mueee nij ghar vaasaa paae ||
lines.translation: Thus you shall ever enjoy your Husband Lord, O mortal bride, and obtain an abode in the home of your own inner being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਏ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paae sabad vajaae sadaa suhaagan naaree ||
lines.translation: Obtaining an abode in the home of her inner being, she vibrates the Word of the Shabad, and is a happy soul-bride forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਲਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੰਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir raleeaalaa joban baalaa anadin ka(n)t savaaree ||
lines.translation: The Husband Lord is delightful, and forever young; night and day, He embellishes His bride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੋ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੋ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har var sohaago masatak bhaago sachai sabad suhaae ||
lines.translation: Her Husband Lord activates the destiny written on her forehead, and she is adorned with the True Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਾ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman har ra(n)g raatee jaa chalai satigur bhaae ||4||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride is imbued with the Love of the Lord, when she walks according to the Will of the True Guru. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਕੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sabh vaapaar bhalaa je sahaje keejai raam ||
lines.translation: All dealings of the Gurmukh are good, if they are accomplished with poise and grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin naam vakhaaneeai laahaa har ras peejai raam ||
lines.translation: Night and day, he repeats the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and he earns his profits, drinking in the subtle essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵੀਜੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: laahaa har ras leejai har raaveejai anadin naam vakhaanai ||
lines.translation: He earns the profit of the subtle essence of the Lord, meditating on the Lord, and repeating the Naam, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਹਿ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun sa(n)grahi avagan vikanahi aapai aap pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: He gathers in merits, and eliminates demerits, and realizes his own self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat paaee vadee vadiaaee sachai sabad ras peejai ||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, he is blessed with glorious greatness; he drinks in the essence of the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har kee bhagat niraalee guramukh viralai keejai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, devotional worship of the Lord is wonderful, but only a few Gurmukhs perform it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੇਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਜਮਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh khetee har a(n)tar beejeeai har leejai sareer jamaae raam ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, plant the crop of the Lord within the field of your body, and let it grow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਘਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੁੰਚੁ ਤੂ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਪਰਥਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapane ghar a(n)dar ras bhu(n)ch too laahaa lai parathaae raam ||
lines.translation: Within the home of your own being, enjoy the Lord's subtle essence, and earn profits in the world hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਪਰਥਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਧਨੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: laahaa parathaae har ma(n)n vasaae dhan khetee vaapaaraa ||
lines.translation: This profit is earned by enshrining the Lord within your mind; blessed is this farming and trade.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam dhiaae ma(n)n vasaae boojhai gur beechaaraa ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Lord's Name, and enshrining Him within your mind, you shall come to understand the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh khetee vanaj kar thaake trisanaa bhukh na jaae ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs have grown weary of this farming and trade; their hunger and thirst will not go away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜਿ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam beej man a(n)dar sachai sabad subhaae ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, plant the seed of the Name within your mind, and adorn yourself with the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਣੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: har vaapaar se jan laage jinaa masatak manee vadabhaago raam ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings engage in the Lord's Trade, who have the jewel of such pre-ordained destiny upon their foreheads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee man nij ghar vasiaa sachai sabad bairaago raam ||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, the soul dwells in the home of the self; through the True Word of the Shabad, she becomes unattached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੋ ਸਚਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukh masatak bhaago sach bairaago saach rate veechaaree ||
lines.translation: By the destiny written upon their foreheads, they become truly unattached, and by reflective meditation, they are imbued with Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa sabh jag bauraanaa sabade haumai maaree ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world is insane; through the Shabad, the ego is conquered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਮਤਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad laag mat upajai guramukh naam sohaago ||
lines.translation: Attached to the True Word of the Shabad, wisdom comes forth. The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Husband Lord.
